title: Chapter 463 Potential Enemies Of The Empire
content:
Chapter 463 Potential Enemies Of The Empire

The golden dragon is no longer a phantom, and its explosive power in a short period of time is comparable to that of the strongest king.

The Black Dragon Sutra has also been cultivated to the peak, and Wang Shuo has also broken through to the strongest king level at this time.

It can be said that stepping into the king is the peak.

Although Wang Shuo has just broken through, most of the strongest kings are no longer Wang Shuo's opponents.

Wang Shuo stood up and looked into the hall.

Lord Zach felt it.

"Come in!"

Wang Shuo walked into the hall and saw countless new novice areas being nurtured.

"How about it, are you interested in these novice areas?"

Lord Zach smiled slightly.

Wang Shuo looked at these novice areas curiously, they were like the prototype of the Great Huai Domain.

"Is it okay?" Wang Shuo asked tentatively.

"Of course."

At this time, Wang Shuo was not very interested in these novice areas.

Compared with the powerful empires of the Shenwu Empire, Wang Shuo was more interested in them.

But Wang Shuo still said: "Okay! What can I do?"

"You can also select some people to enter the novice area and put some pressure on them, but they can't be too strong!"

After Wang Shuo understood the specific rules, he returned to Wana City with pets such as Da Huang.

Wang Shuo's return caused a great sensation to everyone.

Especially Zhao Bangde and others, they were even more anxious.

He wanted to reach the strongest king faster, so that he would have the strength to travel around the continent and find a way to revive Ban Caiyi.

When he heard Wang Shuo say that there was Lord Zak in the Tomb of the King, he was even more excited.

If he could meet Lord Zak, maybe he could directly revive Ban Caiyi.

Although Lord Zak might not agree, it is always a way.

Wang Shuo did not let Zhao Bangde wait too long and handed the token to him directly.

Next, Wang Shuo summoned Ayub and asked about the military strength of the Wana Empire.

"Your Majesty, the empire currently has 5 million troops, including 2 million human soldiers and 3 million monsters of the demon race."

"There are more than 120 general-level masters and more than 50 senior generals."

Wang Shuo was deeply shocked by this set of numbers.

Afterwards, Wang Shuo called Guliji over.

When distributing official positions, Wang Shuo handed over all the spies outside to Guliji.

And gave her a task, which was to find out the military strength of the surrounding empires.

Guliji stood up and said with a bow: "Your Majesty, the current Roland Empire has 2 strongest kings and 10 senior generals."

"In the Mali Dynasty further north of us, there is 1 strongest king and 14 senior generals."

...

Guliji said one by one, and Wang Shuo looked serious.

It is not difficult to defeat the two nearest empires, but the problem is that the nearest third-level empire, the Maka Empire, has 5 strongest kings and more than 50 senior generals.

If the Maka Empire, in conjunction with several other empires, attacks the Vana Empire together, it will be a bit bad.

After all, if the Roland Empire and the Mali Dynasty are captured, the territory will be too large.

It is too difficult to defend.

Wang Shuo plans to accumulate more strength first.

At least several people on his side have the opportunity to break through the strongest king.

After learning about the Tomb of the King, Wang Shuo gathered all the high-level warriors for special training.

In the ancient battlefield, Wang Shuo spent a huge price to simulate the environment in the Tomb of the King. He personally played the opponent and trained Gong Zheng, Ayub and others. The opponents also included Wang Shuo's three strongest king pets.
